title: Cola Bottle Zoom Out
creative_brief: A 12-second cinematic shot starting with an extreme close-up of a hand gripping a glass cola bottle, slowly zooming out to reveal a woman drinking from it in a softly lit indoor setting.
global_visual_style: Cinematic realism, shallow depth of field transitioning to medium depth, warm ambient lighting, high-fidelity texture on glass and skin, smooth camera movement.
overall_soundscape: Subtle room tone, the crisp sound of liquid swirling in a glass bottle, and a distinct gulp as the woman drinks.
non_diegetic_music: A minimal, low-tempo ambient track with soft piano notes that builds gently as the frame widens.
constraints: Maintain consistent lighting direction from the left. Ensure the hand grip on the bottle remains physically realistic throughout the zoom-out. No visible text or logos other than generic cola branding if implied by context, but focus on the glass texture.

shots.camera_movement: Slow, steady dolly out / zoom out
shots.subject_action: A hand firmly grips a glass cola bottle filled with dark amber liquid. Fingers are wrapped around the mid-section of the bottle. Condensation droplets are visible on the glass surface.
shots.environment_response: Soft bokeh background, indistinct shapes suggesting an indoor table surface.
shots.additional_direction: Focus is locked sharply on the hand and the bottle's texture. The zoom out begins subtly, revealing more of the bottle's shoulder.

shots.camera_angle: Slightly low angle looking up at the subject's face
shots.camera_movement: Continued slow dolly out / zoom out
shots.subject_action: The camera reveals a young woman with dark hair tied back. She tilts her head back slightly, bringing the bottle to her lips. Her eyes are closed in enjoyment as she takes a sip.
shots.environment_response: The background becomes clearer, showing a warm-toned interior wall and a hint of a window frame on the right side.
shots.additional_direction: Lighting highlights the contour of her jawline and the reflection on the glass bottle. The transition from hand to face is seamless.

shots.camera_movement: Settle to static or very slow drift
shots.subject_action: The woman lowers the bottle slightly from her lips, a small smile forming on her face. She holds the bottle in one hand, looking forward with a relaxed expression.
shots.environment_response: Full context of the scene is visible: she is seated at a wooden table. The lighting is soft and diffused, creating a cozy atmosphere.
shots.additional_direction: Final frame holds on her satisfied expression. The camera movement stops completely in the last 0.5 seconds to stabilize the shot.

media_requests.prompt: Extreme close-up of a human hand gripping a glass bottle filled with dark cola liquid, condensation on the glass, shallow depth of field, warm lighting, high detail texture.
Medium close-up of a young woman with dark hair drinking from a glass cola bottle, eyes closed, warm indoor lighting, soft background bokeh.
Medium shot of a woman seated at a wooden table holding a glass cola bottle, relaxed smile, soft diffused lighting, cozy interior environment.
